exposure: rupture of membranes before C-section (> 6 hours)
outcome: surgical site infection (SSI) following Cesarean section
cohort: All women admitted to the maternity ward of Ali ibn Abi Talib Hospital in Zahedan who underwent elective or emergency Cesarean sections.
finding: The occurrence of surgical site infection following Cesarean section was 2.26%, with obesity and anemia identified as predominant risk factors.
